fusions.name: Split Stalk
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. Looses 2 spore pods side by side, each dealing 7 damage.

fusions.name: Branching Canker
fusions.desc: Hurls a spore knot that deals 28 damage, ignoring resistances, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. It then splits to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that damage each.

fusions.name: Crossroads Purge
fusions.desc: Draws up to 2 conditions out of you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Offshoot
fusions.desc: When you regain health, a spore bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage, then on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 4 seconds.
